Joongmin Shin

Senior Researcher, Human-Inspired AI Research, Korea University
Founder & Lead, KUDoc

I research structure-aware multimodal reasoning: recovering document structure—layout, tables, figures, hierarchy, cross-page dependencies, and provenance—to turn complex documents into auditable evidence for reliable retrieval, grounded generation, and long-context reasoning. My recent work extends this to evidence-centric memory for multimodal agents.

I am seeking Ph.D. opportunities in multimodal reasoning, structured memory, world models, and planning for future agents. Please reach out via email.

Joongmin Shin*, Gyuho Shim, Jung-hun Lee, Jaehyung Seo
